dynamic_feed.cache_policy: fetch latest_url with cache disabled or append a timestamp/cache-buster; then follow the absolute URLs it returns

frontend_contract: On every page load, fetch dynamic_feed.latest_url first rather than resolving latest.json against the chatgpt.site origin.
Then fetch latest.story_index_url. Do not guess a relative backend base path.
Use each story's route, text_url, text_state, facsimile_route, and reading_order_basis.
When text_url is present, title and byline link to /stories/<slug>/.
The story route fetches text_url and renders display_text as OCR-derived provisional text, with facsimile_route beside it.
Do not hide a story because text is provisional; label the text state compactly.
If backend fetch fails, keep the packaged site snapshot and report fallback state on /reconstruction-status/.
On /reconstruction-status/, show bundle_version, latest.built_utc, story counts, live-vs-fallback state, and the actual backend URL fetched.
A successful backend fetch should never leave a text-ready story as an unlinked contents item.

current_backend_expectation.note: october 2002 currently has a machine-text layer; november 2002 and january 2003 await the next digitization pass

style.case_rule: Keep the publication styling lowercase in site chrome and project labels.
